summary: r2 genuinely closes BOTH r1 CRITICAL blockers and all three must-fixes and four warnings; verified against the repo. BLOCKER-1: the LIVE pytorch-interop job (ci.yml:98) is hardened in-place with the exact same-repo guard, permissions: contents: read, timeout-minutes: 30, continue-on-error preserved (§2.3), and the guard `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || head.repo.full_name == github.repository` correctly PRESERVES the push-to-main flow (verified: on push, event_name != pull_request => true => job still runs). BLOCKER-2: parser PINNED to saphyr as an unconditional test-only dev-dependency, #[cfg] silent-no-op FORBIDDEN, missing parser is a compile error, parse failure panics; AT-3033 meta-assertion added (§6.3). Timeouts (30/90/30 + AT-3034), Mesa honesty (25.2.8-known-bad-only + UNKNOWN/TBD framing + AT-3035), branch-protection posture (§1.4 skip-vs-pending + paths-filter trap, anchored AT-3029), A/B provenance chain, skip_llama_build cache+SHA preflight, and actionlint checksum-pin-or-drop are all present as claimed. AT-3019..3035 verified collision-free (highest pre-existing is AT-3018). The llama pin equality target (AT-3027) is real in scripts/m34_llamacpp_ab.sh:104-105. The design is architecturally complete and correct. I APPROVE. THREE non-architectural residuals — all introduced by the r2 fixes themselves and all one-line AT/doc strengthenings within the existing AT-3032/3033/3029 scope — are attached as BINDING implementation conditions for the Coder; none require an Architect re-spec or a third design cycle.
binding_conditions_for_coder: COND-1 (MEDIUM — AT-3032 scan must be robust to expression-derived runs-on, else it is not actually regression-proof): AT-3032/§2.4 detect self-hosted jobs by finding the literal token `self-hosted` in the runs-on array. Verified: every runs-on in the repo today is a literal array, so there is NO live hole. BUT a FUTURE job written `runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}` / `runs-on: ${{ vars.RUNNER }}` resolves to a self-hosted label at runtime while the string `self-hosted` never appears in the workflow text — it EVADES the literal scan and silently re-opens exactly the hole §2.4 claims to make impossible. The spec forbids expression-based runs-on nowhere. FIX (bake into AT-3032, no Architect re-spec needed): the scan MUST additionally FAIL on any job whose `runs-on` value (a) is or contains a `${{ ... }}` expression, or (b) references a matrix variable — i.e. treat un-statically-resolvable runs-on as a hard failure ('self-hosted jobs must use a literal runs-on label array'), and add a one-line comment to that effect in cross-vendor-*.yml. Un-scannable == fail-closed, not skip.

COND-2 (MEDIUM — AT-3033 meta-assertion floors the wrong thing; AT-3032 can still vacuously pass via an EMPTY selector): AT-3033 asserts the parse ran (doc set non-empty, top-level `jobs` resolved per file). That closes the r1 parser-absent no-op. It does NOT floor the SELF-HOSTED-JOB ENUMERATION count. AT-3032 is a universally-quantified check ('for EACH self-hosted job, assert guard+permissions+timeout'); if the self-hosted-label-matching predicate matches ZERO jobs (a matcher bug, or COND-1's expression case, or a labels-array shape the matcher didn't anticipate), the 'for each' is VACUOUSLY TRUE and AT-3032 passes green with no security check performed — the same vacuous-green class r1 flagged as CRITICAL, moved one level down from parse to selector. FIX (bake into AT-3033/AT-3032): assert a FLOOR — the scan must find AT LEAST the known self-hosted jobs (pytorch-interop + amd-gpu + intel-gpu + cross-vendor-ab + cross-vendor-bless => >=5), and fail if the enumeration is smaller than the count of literal `self-hosted` occurrences found by an independent grep. A universal security assertion must prove its domain is non-empty and complete.

COND-3 (LOW — same-repo guard equates 'same-repo' with 'trusted', which is false for automated bots; forward-defensive doc note): the same-repo fork guard `head.repo.full_name == github.repository` is a FORK guard, not an author-trust guard. Verified knowledge: Dependabot PRs are created from branches IN the repo (dependabot/... refs), so `head.repo.full_name == github.repository` is TRUE for them — they would PASS the guard and run on the self-hosted GPU box. There is NO .github/dependabot.yml today (verified), so this is LATENT, not live. FIX (docs-only, EB1_RUNNER_SETUP.md fork-PR section): note that the same-repo guard does not gate automated-bot or future-collaborator branches; if Dependabot is ever enabled, either exclude it from the self-hosted jobs (`github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'`) or keep 'Require approval for all outside collaborators' as the human backstop. One sentence; forward-defensive.
verified_correct: §2.3 pytorch-interop hardening is EXACT: guard expression (push-flow-preserving), permissions: contents: read, timeout-minutes: 30, continue-on-error preserved. The push-to-main M4.1 flow is NOT broken by the guard (event_name != 'pull_request' short-circuits true on push).

§6.3 saphyr is unconditional (test-only [dev-dependencies], no #[cfg] fallback, compile-error-if-absent, panic-on-parse-failure); serde_yaml correctly rejected as deprecated. Confirmed no YAML parser exists in Cargo.lock today — the pin is a real new dependency, not a false 'already vendored' claim.

Timeouts present on every self-hosted job (30/90/30) with AT-3034; Mesa §5.3 reworded to 25.2.8-known-bad-only + explicit UNKNOWN/TBD known-good framing with AT-3035 asserting no fabricated good-version; §1.4 branch-protection posture (if-skip==PASS vs never-triggered==PENDING-FOREVER, no-paths-filter, don't-mark-required-pre-activation) anchored in AT-3029.

Warnings lowered as claimed: §3.1 A/B provenance chain (github.actor + runner log + embedded vulkaninfo device string, honestly flagged as bounded not cryptographic); §3.1 step 3 skip_llama_build preflight asserts cache present AND `git rev-parse HEAD == 6b80c74…` == pin; §6.4 actionlint version+SHA-256-pinned or droppable with saphyr as the authoritative check (actionlint never load-bearing for security ATs).
AT-3019..AT-3035 collision-free — verified the entire repo's AT-30xx space tops out at AT-3018; no overlap with the new 3019-3035 range.
AT-3027 llama-pin equality is a REAL verifiable assertion — b9542 / 6b80c74f285390368b3c99c5e750f19e9b096e98 exists at scripts/m34_llamacpp_ab.sh:104-105.
warnings: The r2 fixes are hardening-of-hardening: AT-3032 (BLOCKER-1 closer) and AT-3033 (BLOCKER-2 closer) are themselves the two most safety-critical ATs, and the two MEDIUM residuals (COND-1 expression-evasion, COND-2 empty-selector vacuous pass) both weaken those exact two ATs. They are cheap to close but MUST be in the implementation, not deferred — a regression-proof scan that can be evaded by a one-token change, or that green-passes on an empty domain, provides false assurance, which is worse for a SECURITY AT than an honest gap. Enforce COND-1/COND-2 at QA/code-review against the actual eb1_workflow_ci.rs, not just the spec.
vendor_concerns: No new vendor concern in r2. The wave32 typed-skip caveat (§4.1) and the Mesa 25.2.8-known-bad honesty (§5.3, r1 fix) remain correctly and honestly stated; AT-3035 now machine-enforces the no-fabricated-good-version framing. No RADV/ANV claim is over-read.
missing_tests: COND-1: AT-3032 must additionally fail on any self-hosted job whose runs-on is a ${{ }} expression / matrix reference (un-statically-resolvable == fail-closed).

COND-2: AT-3033 (or AT-3032) must floor the self-hosted enumeration count (>=5 known jobs; cross-check against an independent literal grep of `self-hosted`) so the universal security assertion cannot pass over an empty set.
questions_for_architect: None blocking. COND-1/COND-2/COND-3 are implementation-level guardrails that fit inside the existing AT-3032/AT-3033/AT-3029 intent ('present or future self-hosted job'; 'no vacuous pass'; docs fork/security wording) and can be handed straight to the Coder — no re-spec required. If you prefer them explicit in the spec text, a one-line addition to each of AT-3032/3033 and the EB1_RUNNER_SETUP fork section suffices; either way they are BINDING at QA.
